results.rule: Only real products move (no packaging, no unknown SKU)
No location sends more than it holds
Capacity: no store is sent stock beyond what it can hold (in-transit counted)
Minimum display: a giving store stays at or above its minimum for the category
Flagship protection: S++ stores never give a top-20 style
Donor cover: a giving store keeps at least 30 days of cover for the style
results.note: velocity = units sold in the window / days the style was in stock

results.rule: In-transit stock counts as arriving: nothing is sent twice
results.note: checked every line going to a store-size that already has stock on the way

results.rule: Approval: every move above Rs 1,00,000 at MRP is flagged for a human
Data issues are flagged, not acted on
results.note: stock with impossible or conflicting numbers is in no move

results.rule: Snapshot reconciled to the weekly history where they disagreed
results.note: 2 cells corrected from the weekly close

results.rule: Every move is explained in one line
